evidence.reason: The paseo driver now uses the raw_decode end offset to reject any non-whitespace content after the decoded verdict object, so a valid object followed by trailing content such as an invalid object raises ValueError before the verdict is persisted or returned; change committed, tests not run (git-only harness).
